shell.label: Shell
shell.description: The program that starts a new terminal session.

fontSize.label: Font size
fontSize.description: Character size in the terminal, in pixels.

activityIdleMs.label: Unread time window
activityIdleMs.description: How long to wait after the last new line before an activity burst counts as its own event. Only controls how easily the persistent unread dot triggers — the dot itself never expires on its own, only by viewing the tab. In milliseconds.

activityLineThreshold.label: Unread threshold (lines)
activityLineThreshold.description: Minimum number of new lines within the time window before an unviewed terminal tab gets the unread dot.

confirmBeforeDelete.label: Confirm before deleting
confirmBeforeDelete.description: Shows a confirmation prompt before moving a file or folder to the trash.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Controls whether PaneCrew renders light, dark, or matches the system setting.

language.label: Language
language.description: User interface language, applies immediately across all open windows.

zoom.label: UI zoom
zoom.description: Scales the whole interface (same as Shift+Cmd/Ctrl +/-/0). Does not affect terminal font size.

defaultTemplate.label: Default grid template
defaultTemplate.description: The grid layout a newly opened window starts with.

updater.restartDescription: PaneCrew will restart to install version <bold>{{version}}</bold>. Running terminal sessions will end.
updater.error: The update could not be installed.
